ai_synthesis.executive_summary: Automated testing across multiple scenarios revealed consistent failures in content rendering, with skeleton placeholders remaining visible in place of main articles and images. Functional defects are observed in the main feed's inability to fully load, confirmed both by Screenshot AI and cross-device visual evidence. A minor visual misalignment was also noted in the advertisement label, but this does not impact app functionality. Some dynamic visual differences are attributed to actual defects, not transient content noise.
ai_synthesis.release_recommendation: Do NOT release; functional blocking issues are present. Critical rendering defects prevent core content from loading, which must be addressed before production rollout.
